title: Simulation-free Structure Learning for Stochastic Population Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2510.16656v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modeling dynamical systems and unraveling their underlying structural dependencies is central to many domains in the natural sciences. Various physical systems, such as those arising in cell biology, are inherently high-dimensional and stochastic in nature, and admit only partial, noisy state measurements. Our primary motivating setting is single-cell biology, where destructive measurements yield unpaired population snapshots rather than longitudinal trajectories of the same cells. This poses a significant challenge for addressing the problems of modeling the underlying dynamics and inferring the network structure of these systems. Existing methods are typically tailored either for structure learning or modeling dynamics at the population level, but are limited in their ability to address both problems together. translated_title: 随机种群动力学的免模拟结构学习
translated_abstract: 对动力系统进行建模并揭示其潜在的结构依赖关系是自然科学许多领域的核心问题。各种物理系统（例如细胞生物学中出现的系统）本质上是高维且随机的，并且只能获得部分的、含噪声的状态测量。我们的主要动机场景是单细胞生物学，其中破坏性测量产生的是不配对的种群快照，而不是同一细胞的纵向轨迹。这给解决底层动力学建模和这些系统网络结构推断的问题带来了重大挑战。现有方法通常要么专门用于结构学习，要么用于在种群层面建模动力学，但在同时解决这两个问题方面能力有限。在这项工作中，我们同时解决了这两个问题：我们提出了StructureFlow，一种新颖且有原则的免模拟轨迹方法……
tldr: 提出了StructureFlow，一种免模拟的新方法，能够同时完成随机种群动力学的建模与底层网络结构的推断，尤其适用于单细胞生物学中只有不配对种群快照数据的场景。
